newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: WTO sets panel in Canada-Australia salmon row.
newsitem.headline: WTO sets panel in Canada-Australia salmon row.

text.p: The World Trade Organisation (WTO) on Thursday agreed to set up a panel to look into Canadian charges that Australia was violating open trading rules with an import ban on Canadian salmon.

The dispute dates back to October 1995 when Canada first sought consultations under the WTO's dispute settlement procedures, but efforts for a bilateral solution have made little progress, diplomats say.
Trade sources said Canada told a meeting of the WTO's Dispute Settlement Body (DSB) it had been patient but now say no prospect for solving the dispute directly in talks with Australia.
Canberra says its import restrictions are based on strict quarantine regulations but insists these are consistent with WTO rules.
Under DSB procedures, creation of a panel was automatic. Australia blocked the first request at a DSB meeting last month but is not allowed to do so twice.
